verdict.rationale: Custom observability dashboards are a fair question for a cloud hosting platform, but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of dashboard building or of combining metrics across services. One community user praises automatic Prometheus metrics collection, but collecting metrics is an adjacent capability, not custom cross-service dashboards. Another user reports that external monitoring integration is hard.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can build custom dashboards combining metrics from any service
